description: Defines enums, classes, and methods for remoting metrics collection in media streaming, including remoting compatibility, pixel rate support, and session/renderer metrics.

classes.name: SessionMetricsRecorder
classes.description: Records metrics related to remoting sessions, including start/stop events, video pixel rate support, and compatibility status.

classes.name: RendererMetricsRecorder
classes.description: Records metrics related to remote renderer initialization, playout evidence, and data rate estimates.

methods.name: WillStartSession
methods.description: Indicates the start of a remoting session with a trigger.

methods.name: DidStartSession
methods.description: Marks the successful start of a remoting session.

methods.name: StartSessionFailed
methods.description: Records a failure to start a remoting session with a reason.

methods.name: WillStopSession
methods.description: Indicates the intention to stop a remoting session with a trigger.

methods.name: OnPipelineMetadataChanged
methods.description: Updates metadata during a remoting session.

methods.name: OnRemotePlaybackDisabled
methods.description: Records when remote playback is disabled.

methods.name: RecordVideoPixelRateSupport
methods.description: Logs the support status of the video pixel rate.

methods.name: RecordCompatibility
methods.description: Logs the compatibility status of media content for remoting.

methods.name: OnEvidenceOfPlayoutAtReceiver
methods.description: Logs evidence of playout at the receiver.

methods.name: OnAudioRateEstimate
methods.description: Provides an estimated audio data rate.

methods.name: OnVideoRateEstimate
methods.description: Provides an estimated video data rate.
